Hi FPH, shitlady nurse alpaca here again, this time with tales about my coworkers.

My coworkers come in different shapes and sizes. We have the itty bitty commite starting at 4'9, and the giants at 7 somewhere. Tiny spaces

Our patients live in their own rooms, with a tiny kitchen, bedroom and a bathroom. Most of the patients have wheelchairs, so it can be pretty tight amongst their furniture. It's especially tight when you're trying to get the patient from the chair to somewhere else (toilet for example).

Shitlord/lady advantages include being able to fit into these small spaces. I can easily stuff my body between the wall and the wheelchair, or in the bathroom between sink, toilet, wheelchair and patient. This means that I don't have to do anything weird strategical maneuvers to do my job.

Fats, on the other hand, do. "Her stomach hit me in the face"

Peggy is a woman with a medical list that is a mile lon.. She requires time and lots of help from the staff. She sits in a wheelchair and needs support when going to the bathroom. Remember the tiny spaces? Yeah. It's pretty damn tight with the wheelchair standing in the middle of the room, but if you're a shitlord you will have little problems.

The day I learned why fat coworkers didn't use the toilet in our changing room.

My coworker Mommy worked long into her pregnancy. Her midrif had ballooned up a lot and it was visible on her tiny frame. Im pretty sure she gave birth to the hulk but I cant ask her until she's back from maternity leave.
